draft.title: Types of bones
card: longer than wide, such as the femur and humerus. They work as levers, so they suit big movements.
roughly cube shaped, such as the carpals in the wrist. They give support and allow small, fine movements.
thin and often curved, such as the ribs and scapula. They protect organs and give a wide surface for muscles to attach.
odd shapes, such as the vertebrae. Sesamoid bones are small bones set inside a tendon, such as the patella, and they protect the tendon.
draft.remember: A bone's shape suits its job: long for leverage, short for fine movement, flat for protection, irregular for odd shapes, sesamoid inside a tendon.

a.q: Which bone type is the femur, and why does that shape suit its job?
opts: Long, because it works as a lever for big movements
Short, because it allows small and fine movements
Flat, because it protects the organs underneath it
Sesamoid, because it sits inside a tendon
a.why: The femur is longer than it is wide, so it is a long bone. That shape lets it act as a lever for big movements such as running. Short bones are cube shaped and suit fine movements, so they do not describe the femur.
a.clue: Think about the length of the thigh bone compared with its width.

b.q: Jess falls from her bike and lands hard on her shoulder blade. Which type of bone is the scapula?
b.why: The scapula is thin and wide, so it is a flat bone. It protects the area around it and gives muscles a broad surface to attach to. It is not a long bone, because it is not longer than it is wide.
b.clue: Is the shoulder blade long and narrow, or thin and wide?

a.best: Long, because it works as a lever for big movements

proposal.title: Types of bones
card: Long bones, such as the femur, are longer than wide and act as levers for big movements. Short bones, such as the carpals in the wrist, are cube shaped and allow small, fine movements.
Flat bones, such as the ribs, skull and scapula, are thin and often curved. They protect organs and give a broad surface for muscles to attach.
Irregular bones, such as the vertebrae, have complex shapes that fit a particular job. The vertebrae protect the spinal cord and support the body's weight.
Sesamoid bones are a separate type: small bones set inside a tendon, such as the patella. They protect the tendon and improve the muscle's leverage.
proposal.remember: A bone's shape suits its job: long for leverage, short for fine movement, flat and irregular for protection, sesamoid for guarding tendons.
